title: Payoff, Cancellation and Automatic Payment Settings of a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Patient Payment Plan agreement — closing the plan and changing payment settings**

**Payoff.** A Patient Payment Plan is paid off on the day its balance reaches zero.

**Cancellation by the patient.** The patient may cancel an active plan at any time. The cancellation is the patient's own decision, and the remaining balance returns to regular statements where the tier returns the balance on cancellation.

**Automatic payment method.** Automatic payment may be switched between card and ACH at any time, but where the tier requires automatic payment it is never switched off while the plan is open.

**Due day.** The due day may only be changed to another of the tier's due-day choices.

## Summary of the settings

| Change | Allowed |
|---|---|
| Switch automatic payment from card to ACH, or ACH to card | At any time |
| Switch automatic payment off, on a tier that requires automatic payment, while the plan is open | Never |
| Change the due day | Only to another of the tier's due-day choices |
| Cancel an active plan | At any time, by the patient's own decision |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A plan's balance reaches zero with a payment received on 2026-09-01: the plan is paid off on 2026-09-01.
- A patient on a tier offering the 1st and the 15th as due days asks to move the due day from the 1st to the 15th: allowed. A request to move it to the 20th is not, because the 20th is not one of the tier's due-day choices.
